title: Objeto e Âmbito de Aplicação
content_summary: Defines scope and objectives applying to all employers and workers in Portugal including trainees and subcontractors

title: Princípios Gerais de Prevenção
content_summary: Establishes 9 prevention principles: risk avoidance assessment at source adaptation to individual substitution collective priority technical measures information and training

title: Coimas e Sanções Acessórias
content_summary: Administrative fines from €4000 to €120000 for very serious violations including prohibition of activity

title: Objeto e Âmbito
content_summary: Defines scope of Portuguese GDPR national implementation and relationship with EU regulation

title: Tratamento de Dados pelo Empregador
content_summary: Specific provisions for employer processing of employee personal data including video surveillance and biometrics

title: Autoridade de Controlo
content_summary: Establishes CNPD powers including investigations audits orders and power to impose corrective measures

title: Objeto
content_summary: Sets environmental policy objectives including sustainability circular economy and climate adaptation

title: Princípio do Poluidor-Pagador
content_summary: Establishes polluter pays principle strict liability for environmental damage and mandatory remediation

title: Instrumentos de Política de Ambiente
content_summary: Lists environmental policy instruments including EIA SEA licensing emission permits and green taxation

title: Deveres do Trabalhador
content_summary: Lists worker obligations: comply with safety rules use PPE report hazards and participate in training

title: Deveres do Empregador
content_summary: Lists 22 employer duties including risk prevention health surveillance safety information and training provision

title: Acidente de Trabalho
content_summary: Defines work accidents covers commuting accidents and establishes employer liability for compensation

title: Principles relating to processing of personal data
content_summary: Establishes 7 GDPR principles: lawfulness fairness transparency purpose limitation data minimisation accuracy storage limitation and integrity

title: Right to erasure
content_summary: Right to be forgotten - data subjects can request erasure and controllers must comply within 30 days unless exceptions apply

title: General conditions for imposing administrative fines
content_summary: Fine structure: up to €10M or 2% global turnover (lower tier) and €20M or 4% global turnover (upper tier) whichever is higher

title: Employer Obligations
content_summary: Requires employers to ensure worker safety covering all work aspects including equipment chemicals ergonomics and psychosocial risks

title: Workers designation
content_summary: Requires employers to designate competent workers for protection and prevention activities with adequate resources

title: Employers in the same workplace
content_summary: Rules for coordination of safety activities and communication when multiple employers share a single workplace

title: Gefährdungsbeurteilung
content_summary: Requires employers to conduct and document risk assessment for all work activities including physical chemical biological and psychosocial hazards

title: Unterweisung
content_summary: Mandates safety instruction before job start when tasks change for new hazards and at regular intervals

title: Bußgeldvorschriften
content_summary: Administrative fines up to €25000 for non-compliance with risk assessment information and instruction obligations

title: Lawfulness of processing
content_summary: Lists legal bases for personal data processing: consent contract legal obligation vital interests public task and legitimate interest

title: Datenschutzbeauftragte
content_summary: Requires appointment of DPO for public bodies and certain private organizations processing at large scale

title: Sanctions and penalties
content_summary: Sets national fine levels and enforcement authority mapping GDPR administrative fine tiers to German law

title: Genehmigungsbedürftige Anlagen
content_summary: Defines installations requiring permits including power plants chemical plants and waste facilities with emission limits

title: Grundpflichten
content_summary: Requires operators to prevent harmful emissions using best available techniques (BAT) and state of the art technology

title: Ordnungswidrigkeiten
content_summary: Administrative fines up to €50000 for operating without permit or exceeding emission limit values

title: General duties of employers
content_summary: Imposes general duty of care on employers to ensure health safety and welfare of all employees and non-employees affected by work activities

title: General duties of employees
content_summary: Requires employees to take reasonable care for own safety and that of others and cooperate with employer safety measures

title: Powers of inspectors
content_summary: Grants HSE inspectors powers to enter premises examine persons seize items issue improvement prohibition notices and prosecute

title: Principles of processing
content_summary: UK GDPR processing principles mirroring EU GDPR adapted for UK post-Brexit: lawfulness fairness transparency and other principles unchanged

title: Right to erasure
content_summary: UK equivalent of EU GDPR right to erasure - same substantive right with UK-specific procedural elements

title: Penalties
content_summary: ICO enforcement powers: maximum fines £17.5M or 4% global annual turnover for serious breaches whichever is higher

title: Biodiversity targets
content_summary: Sets legally binding targets for species abundance by at least 10% above 2030 baseline and habitat condition improvement by 2042

title: Environmental improvement plans
content_summary: Requires local authorities to develop publish and implement environment improvement plans every 5 years

title: Office for Environmental Protection
content_summary: Establishes independent OEP to monitor environmental law implementation and hold public authorities accountable post-Brexit

title: Hipóteses de Tratamento
content_summary: Establishes 10 legal bases for personal data processing under Brazilian law including consent legitimate interest and legal obligation

title: Direitos do Titular
content_summary: Establishes 9 data subject rights: confirmation access correction deletion anonymisation portability objection review and information on sharing

title: Sanções Administrativas
content_summary: ANPD can impose fines up to 2% of Brazilian annual revenue limited to R$50M per violation and daily fines for ongoing violations

title: Objetivo e Campo de Aplicação
content_summary: Applies to all Brazilian employers establishes minimum safety and health standards and references all other NRs

title: Gerenciamento de Riscos Ocupacionais
content_summary: Requires all employers to implement Occupational Risk Management Program (PGR) proportional to organizational complexity

title: Programa de Gerenciamento de Riscos
content_summary: Defines PGR mandatory components: inventory identification evaluation control and monitoring reviewed every 2 years or after incident

title: Objetivo
content_summary: Establishes employer obligation to provide appropriate certified PPE at no cost to workers where collective measures are insufficient

title: Obrigações do Empregador
content_summary: Employer PPE obligations: acquire certified PPE guide workers provide training enforce correct use maintain replace and record provision

title: Obrigações do Trabalhador
content_summary: Worker obligations: use PPE correctly report defects handle with care and follow employer PPE instructions

title: Duties of employers
content_summary: General duty clause: employers must provide employment and workplace free from recognized hazards causing or likely to cause death or serious harm

title: Inspections investigations records
content_summary: OSHA right to inspect workplaces without prior notice investigate fatalities subpoena witnesses and issue citations and penalties

title: Penalties
content_summary: Civil penalties: up to $15625 per serious violation $15625 per day for failure to abate and up to $156259 for willful or repeated violations

title: Right to know
content_summary: California residents have right to know what personal information businesses collect use disclose and sell about them

title: Right to delete
content_summary: California residents can request deletion of personal information and businesses must comply within 45 days with limited exceptions

title: Administrative fines
content_summary: Civil penalties up to $2500 per unintentional violation and $7500 per intentional violation enforced by California AG

title: National Ambient Air Quality Standards
content_summary: EPA to establish NAAQS for 6 criteria pollutants (PM CO NO2 SO2 Ozone Lead) at levels protecting public health with adequate margin

title: Hazardous Air Pollutants
content_summary: Regulation of 187 listed HAPs from major sources using maximum achievable control technology (MACT) standards

title: Federal Enforcement
content_summary: Federal enforcement authority: civil penalties up to $25000 per day per violation and criminal penalties for knowing violations

title: Cybersecurity risk management measures
content_summary: Essential and important entities must implement proportionate technical organizational and operational measures for cybersecurity risk management

title: Reporting obligations
content_summary: Significant incident reporting: early warning within 24h interim notification within 72h and final report within one month

title: Administrative fines
content_summary: Essential entities: up to €10M or 2% global annual turnover. Important entities: up to €7M or 1.4% global annual turnover

title: Sustainability reporting standards
content_summary: Large companies must report annually on sustainability using European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) covering E S and G

title: Third-party assurance
content_summary: Sustainability reports require limited assurance by accredited statutory auditors increasing to reasonable assurance over time

title: Administrative penalties
content_summary: Member states must ensure effective proportionate dissuasive penalties for CSRD non-compliance including public disclosure
